inference.aggregation: rebuild block-level association statistics in all six presets and 15 trials, then average valid statistics within each Call
inference.call_ci: classical leave-one-Call-out jackknife standard error and point_estimate +/- 1.96*SE; deletion rebuilds all retained mismatch banks
inference.candidate_contrasts: paired Call/source deletions with both candidate mismatch banks rebuilt in every replicate; a Call is retained only when both candidate within-Call excesses are defined; source contrast uses equal-weight retained source means
inference.source_ci: classical leave-one-source-cluster-out jackknife standard error and equal-source point_estimate +/- 1.96*SE; deletion rebuilds all retained mismatch banks
inference.source_estimate: equal-weight source mean: average valid Calls within each retained source, then average retained source means equally

metrics.claim_boundary: non-subjective symbolic feature association only; not musical quality
metrics.contour_interpolation: linear interpolation at equally spaced event-index positions; mean-centered and L2-normalized; fewer than 3 clusters or centered norm <= 1e-12 is NA
metrics.interval_rounding_and_dice: Python ties-to-even round of median-pitch differences, then clipping; multiset Dice is 2*sum(min counts)/(total counts); fewer than 3 clusters is NA
metrics.onset_cluster_rule: start-anchored inclusive window; even cluster median is the arithmetic mean of the two middle pitches
metrics.onset_profile_rule: min(15, floor(16*(t-t0)/(tlast-t0))); L2-normalized counts; fewer than 2 clusters or onset span <= 1e-12 is NA

midi_pairing.mapping: answer-key call_id/trial/seed/candidate validation; response SHA-256 verified against harmonized metrics
midi_pairing.path_redaction: published CSVs contain MIDI filenames and SHA-256 values only

same_condition_mismatch_null.valid_alternative_denominator: dynamic count of available off-diagonal feature similarities; written per trial row

same_source_exclusion_sensitivity.inference: rebuild all masked mismatch banks for the point estimate and every paired delete-one Call/source jackknife replicate
same_source_exclusion_sensitivity.interpretation: all three controlled-minus-raw directions and interval conclusions are unchanged
same_source_exclusion_sensitivity.rule: retain the matched diagonal; exclude an off-diagonal response when its source cluster equals the focal Call source cluster
same_source_exclusion_sensitivity.source_cluster_definition: 77 POP909 song IDs plus 10 artificial Calls
